issues: Removing bracketed spans with an empty string can merge words across brackets, e.g. "foo[bar]baz" becomes "foobaz".
The regex approach does not correctly handle nested square brackets; text inside nested bracket depth can leak into the output.
The default TfidfVectorizer token pattern ignores single-character words, even though the task says words should be keys.
